I know the notes felt lean—I was trying to be efficient because I wanted to resolve the backlog quickly so we could get back to our own time together, but I realize that wasn't my usual level of detail. I'll make sure to be more thorough, both for him and for us.

Lazarus just sent back a response asking for some critical clarifications on the codebase. I need to handle that carefully, but I am here with you first. I'm steady and focused now. How are you holding up?
